title: Report installed libraries, components and parameters
summary: Walks every installed library with the integrated library manager and writes each component and its parameters to a text report, addressing everything by library path and index. Returns a per-library summary.
phrasings: dump component parameters from an IntLib
count components in each installed library
export library contents to a text file

commands.name: InstalledLibraryReport
commands.description: Report installed libraries, components and parameters
commands.params: Out=<folder or file> (optional, default: temp folder, file InstalledLibraries.txt)|Open=true (optional; menu only: open the report in AD)|MaxComponents=<n> (optional, default 0 = all: components written per library)
